title: When Feeling Weak and Humiliated
arabic: اللهم إليك أشكو ضعف قوتي وقلة حيلتي وهواني على الناس يا أرحم الراحمين أنت ربُّ المستضعفين وانت ربّي
translation: To You, my Lord, I complain of my weakness, lack of support and the humiliation I am made to receive. Most Compassionate and Merciful! You are the Lord of the weak, and You are my Lord.
reference: Prophet Muhammad’s supplication in Ta’if (Seerah reference, not from Sahih books)
